main_logical_paths.expansion: 2 models x 12 dates x original1024 paths x 13 original queries =319488 fit records, plus319488 claim records. Fits retain scalar state/root/residual/condition/status/reason/nonfinite sentinels and ndarray roots/extrema/extrema_values/state_bounds. Each small ndarray receives a new descriptor/part/SHA and a tree reference, including empty roots.

Each successful scalar claim retains its own16-block values, covariance and standard_errors arrays, plus numerical values/Greeks/status/error/reason. Repeated scalar dictionaries and nonfinite sentinel objects are literal JSON. All original records are mandatory evidence, but their nested representation has large overhead.

The full base risk is deep-copied three times. Each copy retains models[m].raw.original_path_chunks (all original fit/asian/call date arrays and diagnostics); value is the selected variant saved again. The encoder has no reference memo, so physically repeated data gets fresh array IDs and the full nested JSON tree again.

The position raw embeds the complete bump producer record, and also carries extracted risks, upstream quote-risk source and original market/datasets. The complete large producer tree is therefore contained in each width/cell artifact; width labels differing by a few bytes do not remove the inherited metadata.

Merged risk retains original raw chunk dictionaries, while chunked_worker retains the original chunks and the merged risk; quote_risk also keeps that merged risk as value. Every descendant that embeds the source carries this duplication.

metadata_boundary_method: Canonical writer sorts top-level arrays before schema/tree. Binary seek used 18 x 4096-byte windows with an array-parts descriptor marker, then a 32768-byte boundary window found the exact tree key. Head/tail and five 1024-byte tree samples confirmed the two regions. Descriptor totals exclude about 34 bytes of opening wrapper and include the small schema separator, so they are labelled approximate. Total big-metadata read across the two jobs was 264192 bytes, not the full 1.116GB.
scope: Source and bounded random-access JSON byte windows only; no whole large JSON read/parse, no financial execution and no modifications to source/original artifacts/processes
